traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Nelumbonaceae: leaves simple; veins palmate; stipules present; leaf rosettes none; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior or inferior; floral cup absent; stems herbaceous; flowers solitary; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals or spiral; fruit nut; stamens 200 to 400; carpels 12 to 40. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
